newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent products differentials steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent products differentials steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials were steady in quiet discussion late Friday, traders said.

Basis firmed on higher NYMEX front-month futures prices and reports of a turnaround that idled a catalytic cracker at Conoco's 140,000 barrel per day Ponca City, Okla., for up to 45 days, traders said.

Outages also were affecting crude throughput at Farmland Industries Inc's 68,600 barrel per day Coffeyville, Kansas refinery and National Cooperative Refinery Association's 75,600 bpd McPherson, Kansas refinery, traders said.

In the Midwest, low sulphur diesel basis is expected to firm next week on increased agricultural demand as drier weather moves into the region, allowing farmers to resume autumn corn and sorghum harvests delayed by rain.
"Next week we could see some firmness on low sulphur diesel as the fields dry out and we see more harvest activity," a Group Three trader said.
The Williams pipeline system, a key barometer of stock levels in the region, had 22 days of gasoline and 33 days of low sulphur diesel inventory on hand at week's end, traders said.
Differentials on unleaded gasoline and distillates were unchanged from morning levels in Group Three and Chicago, traders said.
